column1: # In-browser weeb-3 throughput vs PEER COUNT, 2026-08-11. Natural experiment: identical c8 blocks of
# 12 cold references run continuously from page load, through peer buildup, to plateau.
# Block depth (12) and concurrency (8) are CONSTANT across blocks, so the ramp/drain bias that
# understates absolute KB/s is the same in every block and does NOT confound the peer comparison.
# ⛔ Peer count and time-since-node-start are confounded for blocks 0-1 only. Blocks 2-9 sit at a
# flat 82 peers and are within-condition replicates, which give the noise floor.
# ⛔ This node plateaued at 82 connected / 118 connecting, NOT the 200/0 of the other sittings.
# Compare against in-browser-concurrency-sweep-2026-08-11.tsv, whose c8 arm used the identical
# spec at 200 peers and read 268 KB/s.
